content.title: Week’s Best: Charitable Giving Tips for 2025
content.summary: The end of the year often brings a scramble to make charitable contributions, but the One Big Beautiful Bill Act signed into law this summer creates new wrinkles that could complicate the issue.  On the other hand, higher earners who itemize will see a better opportunity to cut their tax bill this year if their charitable contributions top a threshold created by the bill.  For advisors, that could shift the foundation of clients’ retirement plans, raising the question of whether clients should hold on to more capital as a safety net.
